chk_users_branch_by_role.name: chk_users_branch_by_role
chk_users_branch_by_role.value: ("users"."role" IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN') AND "users"."branch_id" IS NULL) OR ("users"."role" NOT IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN') AND "users"."branch_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_operator_session_closed_data.name: chk_operator_session_closed_data
chk_operator_session_closed_data.value: "operator_sessions"."status" <> 'CLOSED' OR ( "operator_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "operator_sessions"."ended_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "operator_sessions"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL )

chk_operator_session_active_data.name: chk_operator_session_active_data
chk_operator_session_active_data.value: "operator_sessions"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR ( "operator_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "operator_sessions"."ended_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "operator_sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL )
